Title: Custom Domain & SSL Production Binding
Reproduction_Steps: Access production domain via custom URL before Cloudflare DNS record binding
Root_Cause: Service currently runs on workers.dev development subdomain; custom apex/www domain not yet bound in Cloudflare dashboard
Business_Risk: Cannot launch commercial operations or acquire Google News publisher accreditation on workers.dev domain
Remediation_Steps: Execute Cloudflare Custom Domain addition for checkindaily.com and www.checkindaily.com with universal SSL
Verification_Criteria: curl -I https://checkindaily.com returns 200 with valid Cloudflare SSL certificate

Title: Media Binary Storage Ceiling in D1
Reproduction_Steps: Upload multiple images > 2MB each in rapid succession
Root_Cause: Cloudflare D1 is SQLite-based and has a 2MB maximum per-row statement limit; large base64 image strings could trigger D1 payload limit
Business_Risk: Potential database write error during high-res photo journalistic uploads
Remediation_Steps: Add Cloudflare R2 bucket binding for direct binary blob storage while keeping metadata in D1
Verification_Criteria: Upload 5MB JPEG and verify successful delivery through CDN URL without D1 bloat

Title: Search Pagination & URL State Persistence
Reproduction_Steps: Search for common keyword like '항공' and attempt to navigate to page 2
Root_Cause: Search query returns initial 24 results but does not support page cursor in URL query string
Business_Risk: Users cannot deep-search back catalog of travel news
Remediation_Steps: Add page=N query param synchronization and server-side LIMIT/OFFSET pagination in d1-api.ts
Verification_Criteria: Search query retains page number on browser refresh and displays results 25-48

Title: Content-Security-Policy Strict Headers
Root_Cause: Security headers include X-Frame-Options and nosniff but lack comprehensive Content-Security-Policy directive
Business_Risk: Risk of XSS exploitation if external CDN or partner script is compromised
Remediation_Steps: Add strict CSP in nitro.config routeRules allowing only approved script/image domains (Unsplash Google AdSense)
Verification_Criteria: SecurityHeaders.com audit score reaches A grade

Title: Canonical Apex Domain Consolidation
Root_Cause: Two valid routes render the same article without 301 redirect or unified canonical tag
Business_Risk: Search engines may penalize duplicate content and split search authority
Remediation_Steps: Add permanent 301 redirect in middleware from /articles/:slug to /news/:category/article/:id
Verification_Criteria: HTTP GET /articles/:slug returns 301 Moved Permanently pointing to canonical path

Title: Corporate Business License Disclosures
Reproduction_Steps: Scroll to footer or policy page
Root_Cause: Company registration number (사업자등록번호) and hosting provider are marked as placeholder pending corporate entity
Business_Risk: Korean Telecommunications and Fair Trade Act compliance requires verified corporate disclosures on commercial websites
Remediation_Steps: Update footer with authentic corporate registration details upon legal entity filing
Verification_Criteria: Verified business registration details displayed in footer across all pages

Title: Image Aspect-Ratio & Layout Shift (CLS)
Reproduction_Steps: Run Lighthouse performance audit on mobile 4G throttle
Root_Cause: Article body figures render without preset height leading to minor CLS of 0.08
Business_Risk: Slight layout movement while reading article on slower mobile connections
Remediation_Steps: Add aspect-ratio: 16/9 and skeleton background placeholder to .article-body-figure in CSS
Verification_Criteria: Lighthouse CLS score <= 0.02 on mobile device profile

Title: Two-Factor Authentication for Admin Accounts
Root_Cause: Authentication relies solely on username and bcrypt password without second factor
Business_Risk: Risk of editorial compromise if admin password is weak or leaked
Remediation_Steps: Integrate TOTP (RFC 6238) authenticator app verification for admin login
Verification_Criteria: Admin login prompts for 6-digit TOTP code after password verification

Title: Affiliate Webhook Dispatch & Conversion Attribution
Root_Cause: Outbound click is logged locally in D1 analytics_events but not forwarded to partner webhook
Business_Risk: Partner cannot immediately reconcile referral traffic in real time
Remediation_Steps: Add async Cloudflare Workers fetch event to dispatch outbound click to partner webhook
Verification_Criteria: Partner endpoint receives conversion ping with ref=checkindaily and target keyword

Title: Dark Mode Input Field Contrast Consistency
Reproduction_Steps: Toggle dark mode and focus mobile search input
Root_Cause: Input field background defaults to light in specific browser auto-fill scenarios
Business_Risk: Visual inconsistency and harsh glare when dark mode is enabled
Remediation_Steps: Add explicit CSS rule for input:-webkit-autofill and input[type="search"] under [data-theme="dark"]
Verification_Criteria: Input background remains dark charcoal #1e293b in all states and browsers

Title: Exchange Rates Redis/KV Edge Cache
Root_Cause: Rates fall back to in-memory module cache which is per-isolate and resets on worker cold start
Business_Risk: Cold start worker isolate may briefly retry external API
Remediation_Steps: Store daily FX snapshot in Cloudflare KV or D1 table for persistent fallback across all global isolates
Verification_Criteria: API returns cached FX rates in under 50ms even when external API is blocked

Title: Article Version History & Revert
Root_Cause: Database maintains updated_at and first_published_at but does not preserve previous markdown revision history
Business_Risk: Editor cannot easily revert to an older draft if unintended changes were published
Remediation_Steps: Add article_revisions table and record snapshot on each update
Verification_Criteria: Admin editor can view revision history diff and restore previous snapshot
